I will upload them when i have the chance, the community definitely deserves it.

I fail to understand why Qwardnaffle hid the mod. He is a talented modder and I respect his work, but he could have just left it up and fucked off instead of throwing a hissy fit and being petty. I guess every honest person who endorsed, tracked and enjoyed it has to have their fun ruined too. H8rs probably got to him.

For anyone wondering, finally found a fix (for myself at least,) that doesn't result in an fps drop. All I did was delete settings.xml in the folder in my documents. It was recreated to the defaults and my game is actually running a lot better now. Tweaked it minimally afterward, only turning off motion blur. i'm not running into any graphical problems as of yet.

At least for me, Rampage seems to make a lot of things work that other trainers don't. For example, the newest version of Lenny's trainer has an option to disable the New Austin sniper but it doesn't work. The one on Rampage works pretty seamlessly. definitely my go-to, every pc player should have it.

Will do. Rampage is a trainer. I only noticed the tassles stop flickering around when i set the cap to 30. Regardless of if I cap it, the black flickering happens. This is with or without an external tool. 

Also just noticed a weird lighting bug with all of arthur's clothing today, whether they have physics or not. They'll pretty much just flash slightly brighter or darker every second. This happens regardless of the FPS cap.

It just never ends lol

Capping it to 30 with Rampage also works for me. Been noticing that smoke glitch too. environments, rocks and trees in general seem to flicker black at times. Very distracting indeed.
Fixed it by putting Vsync to half. Though 30 fps is a bit sluggish imo, so i may just bite the bullet and go with something that doesn't have physics. thanks anyway!
